title: Can Large Language Models Extend Their Agentic Capabilities to Goal Pursuit in Open-Ended Multi-Turn Interaction?
abstract: arXiv:2611.01552v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Goal pursuit in open-ended dialogue requires agents to adapt their actions to interaction feedback across successive exchanges. We investigate whether agentic capabilities developed for multi-step tool use carry over to dialogue organized through the model's native tool interface, and how this changes interaction behavior. We define Tool-Mediated Interaction (TMI) as a training-free protocol that represents dialogue actions as tool calls and counterpart responses as tool results, maintaining a continuous reasoning-action-observation loop with retained reasoning and interaction history. We evaluate TMI across social interaction, emotional support, persuasion, and price negotiation using two models and 15,678 main-experiment episodes. Across both models, TMI improves social goal attainment, emotional-support preference, donation amounts, and buyer negotiation margins over conversational baselines with and without thinking. A Qwen ablation

translated_title: 大语言模型能否将其智能体能力扩展到开放式多轮交互中的目标追求？
translated_abstract: 开放式对话中的目标追求需要智能体在连续的交流中根据交互反馈来调整其行动。我们研究了为多步骤工具使用而开发的智能体能力能否迁移到通过模型原生工具接口组织的对话中，以及这会如何改变交互行为。我们定义了工具介导交互作为一种无需训练的协议，它将对话行动表示为工具调用，将对方的响应表示为工具结果，在保留推理和交互历史的同时，维持持续的推理-行动-观察循环。我们使用两个模型和15,678个主实验回合，在社交互动、情感支持、说服和价格谈判等场景中对TMI进行了评估。在两个模型中，与有思考和无思考的对话基线相比，TMI均提高了社交目标达成度、情感支持偏好、捐赠金额和买方谈判空间。一项针对Qwen的消融实验
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需训练的工具介导交互（TMI）协议，通过将对话行动表示为工具调用来维持持续的推理-行动-观察循环，显著提升了大语言模型在社交互动、情感支持、说服和谈判等开放式多轮对话中的目标达成能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Tool-Mediated Interaction (TMI), a training-free protocol that represents dialogue actions as tool calls to maintain a continuous reasoning-action-observation loop, significantly improving LLMs' goal attainment in open-ended multi-turn dialogues across social interaction, emotional support, persuasion, and negotiation.
